original_record.question: Parallelograms $ABGF$, $CDGB$ and $EFGD$ are drawn so that $ABCDEF$ is a convex hexagon, as shown. If $\angle ABG = 53^o$ and $\angle CDG = 56^o$, what is the measure of $\angle EFG$, in degrees?\n<image1>
original_record.solution: The angles around $G$ must sum to $360^{\circ}$. Using the parallelograms, we have $\angle F G B=$ $180^{\circ}-53^{\circ}=127^{\circ}$ and $\angle B G D=180^{\circ}-56^{\circ}=124^{\circ}$, so $\angle D G F=360^{\circ}-127^{\circ}-124^{\circ}=109^{\circ}$. Then $\angle E F G=180^{\circ}-109^{\circ}=71$.
